messages:
maria-g: Observed a weird one — when rapidly switching orgs in the Console, some widgets briefly show rows from the previous org. Repro in prod 2x this morning.
alexh: ugh. Can you paste a repro flow/steps? UI or API level?
maria-g: UI. Steps: 1) open insights for org A, 2) switch to org B via quick-switch, 3) open the runs list. B shows a mix of A+B rows for ~300ms. Happens more under load.
kai: likely prefetch/cache issue. We recently changed the runlist prefetch to be global to reduce calls. Might be a tenant key missing.
irene: I see telemetry spikes around the same time — trace IDs 0x7a9... show the header X-Org-ID as B but prefetch cache hit from key "runlist:latest" (no org).
samir: can you dump the request/response headers?
maria-g: paste: `GET /api/runs?limit=50` headers: `x-org-id: b-123` then middleware shows cached response served, cache-key=runlist:latest ttl=30s.
dinesh: ohhh that's the bug — cache key omitted org id. We intentionally made a single key for perf but forgot scope on a canary.
alexh: who merged that? I think #3062. Kai can you confirm?
kai: yup that was me, quick perf win. Didn't think about rapid-switch churn. My bad.
maria-g: impact: customers see wrong rows briefly, can confuse account admins. Low frequency but high severity.
ops-bot: INCIDENT-TRIAGE created: INC-2026-045 assigned to eng-platform (priority P2).
dinesh: short-term mitigation: invalidate runlist cache on org-switch event and add server-side double-check (verify org in cached payload).
irene: also need telemetry: add tag cache_org_mismatch=true when cached org != request org. I can search for regressions.
samir: long-term: change cache key scheme to include org id + route fingerprint. Also add unit + e2e for rapid-switch race.
kai: rolling back #3062 would be noisy perf-wise. I'll push a small fix: include org id in key + keep global fallback keyed by config flag. Deploying to canary now.
alexh: ping me once canary is up. Also update rollout config to auto rollback if mismatch metric > 0.1% in 5m.
maria-g: thanks. Leaving a quick reproducer in the ticket. Will monitor customer reports. :eyes:
dinesh: followups: (1) add tenant-scoped cache key enforcement lint, (2) add console integration test simulating rapid org swap, (3) dashboard alert for cache_mismatch_rate.
kai: deploying patch to canary -> 5321000021.
ops-bot: DEPLOY ok: canary-frontend v0.67.3 to eng-platform-canary at 5321000028.
irene: telemetry shows initial drop in mismatch traces after canary. Will keep watching.
alexh: great turnaround. Tossing a postmortem stub into the incident ticket.
maria-g: thanks all. Next: double-check other prefetches (widgets, quickpreview) for similar missing tenant keys.
